teamping.gui.plugin_alt: The TeamPing plugin on the server is too old.
teamping.gui.kiste.tip: Opens the server menu as a chest
teamping.gui.keine_verbindung: No connection to the TeamPing plugin yet.
teamping.gui.server_frage: Are you on a server with TeamPing?
teamping.gui.leiter.text: To %s – you become a normal member.
teamping.gui.kick.text: %s will be removed from the squad.
teamping.gui.pingfarbe.tip:
Your ping colour: %s
Click = pick another free colour
teamping.gui.chat.tip:
Squad chat is %s
ON = your chat messages only go to your squad
(single message: /sc <text>)
teamping.gui.teamfarbe.tip:
Team colour (name colour in chat/tab list)
Click = next colour, Shift+click = previous
teamping.gui.offen.tip:
Open = anyone can join and invite
Closed = only with an invite from the leader
teamping.gui.aufloesen.tip: Disband the squad – all members are removed
teamping.gui.verlassen.tip_leiter: Leave the squad – leadership passes to another member
teamping.gui.name: Name
teamping.gui.name.tip: Squad name: 1–12 characters, only a–z, 0–9 and _
teamping.gui.erstellen.tip: Create the squad – you become the leader
teamping.gui.annehmen.tip: Accept the invite and join squad %s
teamping.gui.keine_squads: No squads yet – create the first one!
teamping.gui.nur_leiter: In closed squads only the leader can invite.
teamping.gui.taste.ping.tip:
Pings the spot you are looking at.
Click, then press a key or mouse button.
ESC = no key
teamping.gui.taste.menu.tip:
Opens this window.
Click, then press a key or mouse button.
ESC = no key
teamping.gui.tasten_reset.tip: Resets both keys (Ping = Z, Menu = G)
teamping.gui.gesten.mehrere: Several ways can be on at once. The ping key of this mod always works.
teamping.geste.F.info: Press F = ping (F no longer swaps hands)
teamping.geste.SHIFT_LINKS.info: Sneak + click into the air = ping
teamping.opt.uebersicht.tip: Shows head, health and distance of your squad members.
teamping.opt.selbst.tip: Also shows yourself in the overview.
teamping.opt.marker.tip:
Shows every ping on screen – even through walls.
Out of view: with an arrow at the edge.
teamping.opt.namen.tip:
On: who pinged what is always shown at the marker.
Off: only while you hold Tab (player list).
teamping.opt.xaero.tip:
Shows pings as waypoints on the minimap and world map.
Ping on the map: middle click or double click.
teamping.opt.ort.tip:
Where the squad overview is shown.
Click = next position, Shift+click = previous
teamping.opt.markerort.tip:
At ping: the marker sits right on the target (arrow at the edge when out of view).
Top/Bottom: as a compass bar.
Click = toggle
teamping.gui.taste_druecken: Press a key or mouse button – ESC = none
teamping.karte.dimension: You can only ping in your current dimension
teamping.server_ohne: This server does not support TeamPing.
teamping.opt.max.tip:
At most this many members are shown in the overview.
The rest is counted as “+N more”.
Offline players are only listed in the window.
teamping.opt.sort.tip:
Nearest = you on top, then low-health members, then the closest.
Reorders calmly (at most once per second, only for 10 m+ differences).
Fixed = squad order, never changes.
teamping.gui.gesten.hinweis: Detected by the server · work without the mod
teamping.opt.uebersicht.kurz: Heads, health and distance of your squad
teamping.opt.selbst.kurz: Show yourself at the top of the overview
teamping.opt.xaero.kurz: As waypoints · map ping: middle click
teamping.karten.titel: Maps & other mods on your PC
teamping.opt.dh.tip:
Ping beyond your render distance: aiming at land that only
Distant Horizons shows finds the spot there.
Only if Distant Horizons is installed.
teamping.opt.dh.kurz: Pings into the DH distance (up to 4 km)
teamping.karten.weit1: Far pings: beyond 250 m the mod sends
teamping.karten.weit3: With DH even beyond render distance.
teamping.aussehen.text: Only for you – others see their own setting.
teamping.aussehen.art.tip:
Light beam: coloured band up into the sky.
Dot only: no beam – just label and marker.
